resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service list says only that the cabin burned in 1936. Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.org describe the whole lookout as gone. The story reports both. None of the sources says when or how the steel tower was taken down.

notes_for_editor: Four sources. The 1936 build year and the fire agree across all three history sites, and the Forest Service list (compiled June 2016) is the official-style record. Brief's status 'gone' is confirmed; brief's access 'unknown' is kept, so no access level is set. No staffing history found: Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history for this lookout, so staffing is left out. No source describes what remains at the site today. Height_m is converted from the 90-foot tower height (27.4 m). Brief coordinates match firelookout.org exactly (46.71996, -114.8751). No corrections to the brief's record. Visit.climbable was dropped: no source says whether the site can be climbed. The sources give 'Kelly Creek R.S.'; 'Ranger Station' is the usual expansion of that abbreviation and is not quoted.
